26 (Currently Amended) A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is a propionic acid NSAID, an acetic acid NSAID or a salicylic acid NSAID, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved, and wherein the non-aqueous carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

41 (Currently Amended) A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and aspirin NSAID, said aspirin NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of aspirin NSAID to biocompatible oil carrier of about 5:1 to about 1:5, and wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.

44 (Currently Amended) A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and ibuprofen NSAID, said ibuprofen NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of ibuprofen NSAID to non-aqueous biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, and wherein the biocompatible oil carrier does not include a triglyceride oil.
